title: flash_decrypt: missing wc_RsaSetRNG causes RSA decrypt to always fail
description: flash_decrypt in src/wp11_backend_usb_flash.c initializes an RsaKey and calls wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode then wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt, but never calls wc_RsaSetRNG. When WC_RSA_BLINDING is enabled (the wolfCrypt default), wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt pulls the RNG out of the key struct internally to generate a blinding factor. If that pointer is NULL (never set), it returns BAD_FUNC_ARG immediately before doing any crypto. Every RSA decrypt via a flash key fails unconditionally. The sign path works because wc_RsaSSL_Sign takes an explicit RNG parameter and does not use the one in the key struct. Fix: add WC_RNG, call wc_InitRng, wc_RsaSetRNG, decrypt, wc_FreeRng — matching the pattern already in flash_sign and in wp11_soft_key_new_rsa2048.
